CustomField.label: Status
CustomField.description: The current operational state of this integration. Active means the integration is live today and any impact it would suffer from a metadata change is real and immediate. Deprecated means the integration still exists in configuration but should no longer be treated as a live dependency, and is a candidate for cleanup. Planned means the integration does not yet send or receive live data but is expected to soon, so it should be considered when planning future-facing changes even though it has no current-day impact.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Current operational state of this integration.
